name: Predefined Medicaid MAX-TAF Admissions Datasets
description: Predefined Medicaid MAX-TAF admissions datasets contain outcome-specific Medicaid inpatient admission products derived from harmonized MAX and TAF inpatient claims using configured diagnosis-code, diagnosis-position, and admission-selection rules.

name: Predefined Medicaid MAX-TAF Admissions V1 Datasets
description: Outcome-specific Medicaid MAX-TAF inpatient admission products covering all states from 2000-2018. Each outcome has its own folder (e.g., mental_health/) containing qualifying admission files and county/ZCTA yearly and daily admission counts, with the outcome definition encoded in the file name as icdset<N>_dx<positions>_<selection> (e.g., admissions_icdset1_dxall_all_yyyy.parquet). State coverage varies during the 2014-2015 MAX-to-TAF transition.

license.name: No license, user must be under Data User Agreement (DUA)

name: Mental Health Admissions
description: Mental health Medicaid MAX-TAF inpatient admission outcomes. Admission files are named by outcome definition as admissions_icdset<N>_dx<positions>_<selection>_yyyy.parquet; aggregate counts are in <geography>/counts_yyyy.parquet. Current definition: icdset1_dxall_all, where a qualifying admission has a mental health diagnosis code from ICD code set 1 in any diagnosis position (dxall), including all qualifying admissions without readmission exclusions (all). Placeholder definition; code set details to be added.

name: Mental Health Qualifying Admissions
description: Beneficiary-admission file containing Medicaid MAX-TAF inpatient stays that meet the icdset1_dxall_all outcome definition (a mental health ICD code in any diagnosis position), with the outcome definition metadata.

content.bene_id: String: Unique beneficiary identifier (from the inpatient file).
content.year: Int32: Admission year, as in the inpatient file.
content.adm_id: String: Stay identifier from the inpatient file; join to inpatient_yyyy.parquet on adm_id for the full stay record.
content.srvc_bgn_dt: Date: Beginning date of service covered by the claim.
content.srvc_end_dt: Date: Latest date of service for the stay.
content.outcome: String: Outcome definition name, <short_name>_<icd_codeset>_<criteria_name> (the file name without the year).
content.short_name: String: Outcome short name from the outcome yaml (e.g. mental_health).
content.long_name: String: Outcome long name from the outcome yaml (e.g. Mental health disorders (any)).
content.icd_codeset: String: Name of the ICD-9/ICD-10 code set in the outcome yaml that the admission matched.
content.criteria_name: String: Name of the inclusion criterion within the code set.
content.definition_author: String: Author of the inclusion criterion, if given in the outcome yaml; otherwise NULL.
content.outcome_criteria: String: Matching rule. dx_position_<N> = a code in position N (1 = primary); dx_position_<A>-<B> = a code in positions A through B; dx_position_<A>- = a code in position A through the last position; conditional = primary diagnosis in the primary code list and a secondary diagnosis (positions 2-25) in the secondary code list.
content.diagnoses: List[String]: Diagnosis codes of the stay, as in the inpatient file. conditional criteria only.
content.primary_dx: String: Primary diagnosis, diagnoses[1]. conditional criteria only.
content.secondary_dx: List[String]: Secondary diagnoses, positions 2-25. conditional criteria only.

content.Row definition: One row per inpatient stay (adm_id) in the Medicaid MAX-TAF inpatient file that matches the outcome definition. Denominator cohort flags are not carried on this file; join to the denominator on bene_id (and year) to get them.
content.Outcome definitions: Each outcome is defined in its own yaml: one or more ICD-9/ICD-10 code sets, each with one or more inclusion criteria. Codes are matched exactly against diagnoses at the given diagnosis position(s); positions outside the range are ignored. One file is written per inclusion criterion and year.

name: Daily County-Level Outcome Counts
description: Daily County-level counts of mental health qualifying Medicaid MAX-TAF inpatient admissions (n_adm__<cohort>) for the `icdset1_dxall_all` definition. Cohorts: total, ffs (fee-for-service all year), dual (dual-eligible all year), disabled (disability-based eligibility all year), full_benefit (full Medicaid benefits all year).
